title: The False Astrogator
logline: A navigation instructor discovers their star student altered historical gate logs to earn a premier convoy commission, and both want an outsider's ship between them.

roles.description: A veteran astrogator whose word can make or break a cadet's commercial career.
Gifted, intensely ambitious student burdened by crushing family expectations.
A fast light courier the cadet uses to run gate simulation trials.
The civilian annex where official gate navigation logs are deposited for certification.

public_situation: The system's annual astrogation honours are delayed after conflicting calibration records were filed for the flagship gate course.
private_truth: The cadet's influential family paid off the archive registrar to swap real navigational test logs with pre-calculated algorithmic simulations.

beats.public_change: The navigation board flags an anomalous entry in the cadet's certified jump track.

missions.reason: The instructor needs a pilot to scan the archive's exterior optical bus to confirm whether the cadet's run was uploaded from orbit or fed through an internal terminal.
missions.private_fact: The instructor previously accepted family campaign donations to overlook earlier test inconsistencies.

beats.public_change: The cadet launches in their courier and hails pilots from outside the station perimeter.

missions.reason: The cadet hires the pilot to buy replacement optical logic cores to overwrite the flagged log sector before the formal board review.
missions.private_fact: The cadet knows that admitting the fraud will destroy their family's credit standing across three neighboring systems.

beats.public_change: The cadet refuses to dock their shuttle until the instructor signs off on the commission recommendation.

missions.reason: The instructor asks the pilot to disable the runaway shuttle's propulsion manifold before the cadet jumps into dark space.
missions.private_fact: The cadet hails the pilot mid-flight offering an offshore investment bond and proprietary jump charts to break off the interception.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot corners the disabled shuttle, holding both the falsified logs and the cadet's career in their hands.

options.label: Hand the forged records to the exam tribunal
Press the instructor to sign a remedial passing grade in exchange for silence
Take the cadet's voucher and wipe the archive logs

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the shuttle and submits the forged records.
resolutions.summary: {role:nav_cadet} is stripped of honours and barred from flight, while {role:senior_navigator} faces inquiries over delayed reporting.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot caught an aristocratic cadet faking gate coordinates to steal a command berth.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces a quiet remedial compromise.
resolutions.summary: {role:senior_navigator} assigns {role:nav_cadet} to two years of uncredited deep-space survey labor, burying the scandal.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the overwrite cores or buries the dossier.
resolutions.summary: {role:nav_cadet} takes command of a luxury convoy route, while {role:senior_navigator} quietly requests a transfer.

consequences.public_summary: Word spread that a well-connected cadet bought their pilot wings with forged survey logs.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the cadet's bribe or lets the shuttle jump away.
resolutions.summary: {role:nav_cadet} slips past the gate network into unregulated frontier space, leaving forged registry entries unresolved.

loose_threads.detail: The archive clerk who certified the cadet's flight time resigned under an identity that had expired three months earlier.
The cadet's family estate posted letters of credit backed by an unchartered jump route patent.

radio_hooks: Astrogation honours delayed in {system} pending registry audit.
Private shuttle sightings increase near {role:naval_archive_dock} outer boundary.

voice_direction.senior_navigator: Weary, formal diction, pauses frequently before speaking. Never raises tone even when furious.
voice_direction.nav_cadet: Stiff, rehearsed confidence that cracks into desperate bargaining under pressure.
